W.note: Tidy four-up grid with search, category chips, sort, and a real cart drawer with totals and checkout, though the gradient initials tiles read as placeholders and the mobile cards are tall.

X.note: The densest and most restrained design, with refined line-art glyphs, a blue accent, and clear add/adjust/remove feedback in an inline bag, but it has no checkout action, search, or filtering.

Y.note: Tall 4:5 tiles leave a stranded third-row card under a sticky review bar that covers content on mobile, so it is less compact than the others despite clean per-card status text.

Z.note: The most complete shopping flow (search, sort, stock flags, sold-out state, drawer with tax and free-shipping hint), but emoji product art, shadows, and badges add clutter and a dated feel, and the mobile chip row clips.
